channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: GTA VI pre-loads open November 10 and the game needs 212GB
item.description: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI can be pre-loaded from November 10 ahead of its November 19 launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO filing warns it may be close to self-improving AI
item.description: Anthropic's amended S-1 says future models may soon meet its internal threshold for dramatically accelerated, AI-driven research progress.

item.title: Bethesda finally names The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel in a new teaser
item.description: A short Bethesda Game Studios 40th anniversary video ended with the first new Elder Scrolls VI teaser since 2018, confirming the name Sentinel.

item.title: Ocarina of Time remake launches November 5 with reviews due this week
item.description: Nintendo's Switch 2 rebuild of Ocarina of Time launches Thursday, with review scores expected around midweek.

item.title: AMD posts a record $13.4 billion quarter and guides to about $17 billion
item.description: AMD's third-quarter revenue rose 45% to $13.4 billion, led by a record $8.5 billion from data center chips, up 97%.

item.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon edges past Claude Opus 5.5 on a key AI leaderboard
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon scored 59 on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, one point above Claude Opus 5.5, at lower cost per task.

item.title: Ramayana: Part 1 opens November 5 with over ₹63 crore in global advance sales
item.description: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Part 1, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash, has about ₹63.48 crore in worldwide advance bookings.

item.title: Anthropic's updated IPO filing shows about $17 billion in third-quarter revenue
item.description: An amended S-1 shows Anthropic's Q3 revenue at about $17 billion, up roughly elevenfold, with a $23.3 billion net loss.

item.title: Nvidia is said to require cloud partners to sell mostly to non-Chinese customers
item.description: The Financial Times reports Nvidia told cloud customers to sell at least 51% of their services to non-Chinese companies.

item.title: Anthropic is said to seek up to $3.5 billion from Japan as IPO price talks go on
item.description: Bloomberg says Anthropic wants up to $3.5 billion from Japanese investors in its IPO, as big funds reportedly push for a $1.5 trillion value.

item.title: Godzilla Minus Zero arrives November 6 with a 92% critics' score
item.description: Toho's sequel to Godzilla Minus One opens in North America on November 6, with early reviews at 92% on Rotten Tomatoes.

item.title: Red Hat patches a 9.8-rated Linux flaw that an AI model exploited
item.description: Red Hat has fixed CVE-2026-98432, a critical Linux kernel TCP bug, while Ubuntu's main fixes are still in testing.

item.title: Ubisoft is reported to have bid for Arkane, the studio making Marvel's Blade
item.description: Bloomberg reports Ubisoft has submitted a bid for Microsoft's Arkane, the Dishonored studio, as Xbox looks to sell it.

item.title: Apple reports a record $114.5 billion quarter in Ternus's first results as CEO
item.description: Apple's fiscal fourth-quarter revenue rose 12% to $114.5 billion, with iPhone up 17% and China sales up 21%.

item.title: WIRED finds over 400 ordinary-looking AI apps hiding abusive deepfake tools
item.description: A WIRED investigation tied more than 400 apps and sites, some in Apple's and Google's stores, to one network offering sexual deepfake features.

item.title: Lupin Part 4 leads Netflix's non-English chart with 10.8 million views
item.description: The French heist series' fourth part topped Netflix's non-English TV list for the week to November 1, with viewing hours up about 71%.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero sells over 4 million copies in three days
item.description: S-GAME says its action game Phantom Blade Zero sold more than 4 million copies in 72 hours after its October 29 launch.

item.title: Marvell agrees to buy Lumentum in a $115 billion all-stock deal
item.description: Marvell will pay 4.5 of its shares for each Lumentum share, valuing the optical-parts maker at about $115 billion including debt.

item.title: Anthropic confirms Claude Code limits meant to stop cloning specific games
item.description: Anthropic says Claude Code now has instructions to avoid recreating specific existing games, citing its intellectual property policy.

item.title: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil passes $400 million worldwide
item.description: Sony's Resident Evil reboot has crossed $400 million worldwide and is reported to reach digital purchase and rental on November 3.

item.title: Indie developers say slow Steam reviews are delaying their launches
item.description: Developers told Kotaku that Valve's game reviews took two to three weeks in October, and they suspect a flood of AI-made games.

item.title: Netflix's Matthew Perry documentary debuts at No. 1 with 9.5 million views
item.description: The One About Matthew Perry led Netflix's English TV chart for the week to November 1 with 9.5 million views.

item.title: Supermarkets in five European countries report suspected hacks of their freezers
item.description: Supermarkets in Belgium, Sweden and three other European countries reported fridge and freezer temperature spikes from suspected cyberattacks.

item.title: Apple's first touchscreen Macs and an OLED iPad mini go on sale Friday
item.description: Apple releases five products on November 6, including OLED touchscreen MacBook Pros from $2,899 and an OLED iPad mini at $699.

item.title: OpenAI signs four deals with Abu Dhabi covering government, energy and investment
item.description: OpenAI signed four agreements with Abu Dhabi spanning government services, energy operations and sovereign investment, Semafor reports.

item.title: Jailer 2 passes ₹800 crore to become the top-grossing Tamil film
item.description: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has taken about ₹807 crore worldwide in 18 days, passing his own 2.0 as the biggest Tamil film ever.

item.title: Mass Effect's N7 Day arrives weeks after EA shut down BioWare
item.description: BioWare appears to have lined up N7 Day merchandise before EA closed the studio, and fans are using the day for a Save Mass Effect push.

item.title: OpenAI launches a program to cut data center power use when the grid is strained
item.description: OpenAI's Grid Protectors Program aims to reduce electricity demand from its future data center campuses during emergencies and extreme weather.

item.title: Xbox puts a Series X inside an alligator to hint at GTA VI without naming it
item.description: Xbox unveiled the Series X-BITE, a one-off console inside a five-foot animatronic alligator, offered through a sweepstakes.

item.title: New Windows malware sends stolen data to Claude to rank victims by value
item.description: Researchers found an infostealer that feeds stolen personal and financial data to an AI model to judge which victims are worth the most.

item.title: SemiAnalysis's new GDPx test finds the best AI model scores 12%
item.description: GDPx tests frontier models on hard work in 11 fields, and Claude Opus 5.5 leads with 12.0%.

item.title: Clayface leads the worldwide box office in its second weekend
item.description: DC Studios' Clayface topped the global chart with about $23 million, taking its worldwide total to about $83 million.

item.title: World of Warcraft: Forever launches with over 1,000 new quests
item.description: Blizzard's new take on early Azeroth, World of Warcraft: Forever, launches on PC on November 4 with a level-60 cap.

item.title: Oracle files to raise $20 billion in stock and bonds for its AI build-out
item.description: Oracle plans to sell $10 billion of new shares and $10 billion of bonds, and its stock closed down 8.8%.

item.title: Nobody Wants This season 3 slips to No. 2 with 7.2 million views
item.description: The romantic comedy drew 7.2 million views in its second week, behind the new Matthew Perry documentary.

item.title: Salesforce is said to be buying contact-center AI maker Cresta for $2.7 billion
item.description: The Information reports Salesforce plans to acquire Cresta, which makes AI software for customer service centers, for about $2.7 billion.

item.title: Goldman Sachs pulls advanced AI coding tools from many traders and bankers
item.description: Goldman has restricted tools including Claude Code for many traders and bankers, leaving them largely to its engineers.

item.title: Circana data shows Modern Warfare 4 launched with fewer console players than Black Ops 7
item.description: Modern Warfare 4 took 19% of US PlayStation play in launch week, against 23% for Black Ops 7, but did better on Steam.

item.title: Palantir's US commercial revenue jumps 148% and passes government sales
item.description: Palantir's third-quarter revenue rose 96% to $2.31 billion, and it raised its full-year forecast to about $8.53 billion.

item.title: OpenAI's new LifeVal benchmark tests AI on everyday chores like childcare and budgets
item.description: LifeVal measures whether AI can handle daily tasks such as finding childcare, managing a budget and navigating government paperwork.

item.title: A Switch 2 Lite is rumored at about $299 with a 7.1-inch screen
item.description: Leaks reported by GameGPU say Nintendo is planning a handheld-only Switch 2 Lite with a smaller screen and a lower price.

item.title: Netflix premieres Bass X Machina, a steampunk anime about lawman Bass Reeves
item.description: The six-episode animated series from Yasuke creator LeSean Thomas reimagines US marshal Bass Reeves in a steampunk Old West.

item.title: Sony is making a Mouthwashing film with director Karyn Kusama
item.description: Sony has picked up film rights to the 2024 indie horror game Mouthwashing, with Karyn Kusama set to direct.
